opportunities.title: GoHighLevel Real Estate Systems Architect
opportunities.description: GoHighLevel (GHL) Systems Architect – Full Account Audit, Multi-Segment Setup & Automation Project Overview I am looking for an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM, Automation & Systems Architect to audit, organize, and fully build out my existing GHL account. I run a solo real estate business that spans multiple segments (Residential Buyers/Sellers, Leasing, Commercial Real Estate, and Business Brokerage). I am not looking for a basic landing page builder. I need someone who understands CRM strategy + data segmentation + advanced deliverability, who can clean up my existing assets while implementing a precise technical blueprint I have already mapped out. What I Have Already • An active GHL account and custom website with multiple features. • Existing leads, contacts, and past client databases (needs cleaning/segmenting). • Scraped lists and business registries ready for outbound prospecting. • Scattershot funnels and automations that need to be audited, improved, or replaced. Scope of Work & Technical Blueprint Phase 1: Audit, Cleanup & Data Segmentation • System Audit: Review all existing workflows, forms, and triggers. Delete or archive broken or redundant automations to clean up the account. • Master Sub-Account Structure: Organize all data within one single master sub-account (no fragmented sub-accounts). • Contact Cleansing: Clean, deduplicate, and segment my existing contact database using specific master tags (Segment: Buyer, Segment: Seller, Segment: Commercial, etc.). Phase 2: Core Architecture & 6 Custom Pipelines You will build and configure 6 distinct Kanban pipelines with unique milestone stages tailored to each asset class: 1. Residential Buyers 2. Residential Sellers 3. Residential Leasing (Application, background check, lease stages) 4. Commercial Real Estate (Buyers/Sellers) (NDA, LOI, due diligence stages) 5. Business For Sale (Valuation, CIM prep, marketing stages) 6. Outbound Prospecting Pipeline (A dedicated "buffer" pipeline to filter raw/scraped cold leads before they hit my main business metrics) Phase 3: Outbound Isolation & Deliverability Configuration • Domain Isolation: Integrate a secondary "lookalike" cold email domain specifically for outbound prospecting to protect my main website domain’s sender reputation. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. • Outbound Phone Setup: Configure a secondary GHL tracking line with A2P 10DLC parameters strictly for manual outbound sprints. Phase 4: Workflow Automations & Handraiser Controls • The Inbound Reply Stop: Build an automated trigger where any reply to a cold outbound campaign instantly pauses the automation, moves the contact to Handraiser / Reply Received in the Prospecting Pipeline, and shoots an Instant Push Notification to my phone via the LeadConnector app (linking directly to the conversation). • Mobile Call-Logging Triggers: Build workflows mapped to 4 custom tags (Call: Left Voicemail, Call: No Answer, Call: Callback Requested, Call: Gatekeeper Block). When I apply these tags in the GHL mobile power-dialer, GHL must automatically update the opportunity stage and schedule the next follow-up task. Phase 5: Nurturing, Reporting & Training • Re-engagement Campaigns: Set up automated past-client, referral, and database re-engagement campaigns. • Attribution Reporting: Configure dashboard widgets so I can filter conversion rates and pipeline values by individual business segments. • Hand-off & Training: Provide a live walkthrough or short recorded training session showing me exactly how to navigate the new, cleaned system. Proposed Project Milestones (Escrow Release) Payment will be split into three strict milestones based on deliverables: • Milestone 1 (20%): Completion of the GHL account audit, database cleanup, domain isolation setup, and tag restructuring. • Milestone 2 (50%): Successful build of all 6 pipelines, conditional custom fields, cold outreach workflows, and mobile app call-logging automations (Fully Tested). • Milestone 3 (30%): Re-engagement campaigns live, dashboard reporting verified, and final training/hand-off completed. Submission Requirements (Proposals ignoring this will be archived) To be considered, your proposal MUST include: 1. Fixed-Price Quote: Provide the total, all-inclusive price for the complete project based on the scope above. No placeholder bids. 2. Timeline: How many days will this take you from start to finish? 3. Work Samples: Provide screenshots or a short video of a GHL architecture, pipeline system, or multi-channel workflow you have personally built (real estate focus is a massive plus). 4. Screening Question: Answer this in your application: “How do you prevent a cold lead from continuing to receive automated emails once they manually reply to a GHL workflow?” (This proves you read the description.)

I run a solo real estate business that spans multiple segments (Residential Buyers/Sellers, Leasing, Commercial Real Estate, and Business Brokerage). I am not looking for a basic landing page builder. I need someone who understands CRM strategy + data segmentation + advanced deliverability, who can clean up my existing assets while implementing a precise technical blueprint I have already mapped out. What I Have Already • An active GHL account and custom website with multiple features. • Existing leads, contacts, and past client databases (needs cleaning/segmenting). • Scraped lists and business registries ready for outbound prospecting. • Scattershot funnels and automations that need to be audited, improved, or replaced. Scope of Work & Technical Blueprint Phase 1: Audit, Cleanup & Data Segmentation • System Audit: Review all existing workflows, forms, and triggers. Delete or archive broken or redundant automations to clean up the account. • Master Sub-Account Structure: Organize all data within one single master sub-account (no fragmented sub-accounts). • Contact Cleansing: Clean, deduplicate, and segment my existing contact database using specific master tags (Segment: Buyer, Segment: Seller, Segment: Commercial, etc.). Phase 2: Core Architecture & 6 Custom Pipelines You will build and configure 6 distinct Kanban pipelines with unique milestone stages tailored to each asset class: 1. Residential Buyers 2. Residential Sellers 3. Residential Leasing (Application, background check, lease stages) 4. Commercial Real Estate (Buyers/Sellers) (NDA, LOI, due diligence stages) 5. Business For Sale (Valuation, CIM prep, marketing stages) 6. Outbound Prospecting Pipeline (A dedicated "buffer" pipeline to filter raw/scraped cold leads before they hit my main business metrics) Phase 3: Outbound Isolation & Deliverability Configuration • Domain Isolation: Integrate a secondary "lookalike" cold email domain specifically for outbound prospecting to protect my main website domain’s sender reputation. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. • Outbound Phone Setup: Configure a secondary GHL tracking line with A2P 10DLC parameters strictly for manual outbound sprints. Phase 4: Workflow Automations & Handraiser Controls • The Inbound Reply Stop: Build an automated trigger where any reply to a cold outbound campaign instantly pauses the automation, moves the contact to Handraiser / Reply Received in the Prospecting Pipeline, and shoots an Instant Push Notification to my phone via the LeadConnector app (linking directly to the conversation). • Mobile Call-Logging Triggers: Build workflows mapped to 4 custom tags (Call: Left Voicemail, Call: No Answer, Call: Callback Requested, Call: Gatekeeper Block). When I apply these tags in the GHL mobile power-dialer, GHL must automatically update the opportunity stage and schedule the next follow-up task. Phase 5: Nurturing, Reporting & Training • Re-engagement Campaigns: Set up automated past-client, referral, and database re-engagement campaigns. • Attribution Reporting: Configure dashboard widgets so I can filter conversion rates and pipeline values by individual business segments. • Hand-off & Training: Provide a live walkthrough or short recorded training session showing me exactly how to navigate the new, cleaned system. Fixed-Price Quote: Provide the total, all-inclusive price for the complete project based on the scope above. No placeholder bids. 2. Timeline: How many days will this take you from start to finish? 3. Work Samples: Provide screenshots or a short video of a GHL architecture, pipeline system, or multi-channel workflow you have personally built (real estate focus is a massive plus). 4. opportunities.title: Asistente WhatsApp Atención a Clientes
opportunities.description: Quiero implementar un asistente virtual en WhatsApp Business que atienda las consultas diarias de mis clientes de forma automática y, cuando detecte un caso complejo, lo redirija a un operador humano sin perder el historial de la conversación. Qué debe hacer el asistente • Reconocer preguntas habituales y responderlas en el mismo hilo. • Consultar la información de cada cliente sobre pedidos, reservas o citas para dar detalles de estado, horarios o cambios. • Escalar cualquier consulta fuera de lo previsto a un número o chat interno con un agente humano, indicando el motivo y adjuntando el contexto. Fuente de datos disponible Toda la información de pedidos y reservas está dispersa en las propias conversaciones de WhatsApp o en registros manuales. Necesito una propuesta que extraiga esos datos de manera estructurada o, si lo prefieres, plantee una forma sencilla de que yo alimente al bot con esa información (por ejemplo, mediante etiquetas, mensajes con formato o una pequeña base externa). Entrego • Ejemplos de conversaciones reales para entrenar al bot. • Lista de respuestas modelo y reglas de escalamiento que ya utilizo manualmente. Espero • Configuración completa en la plataforma que sugieras (WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, ManyChat, Dialogflow, etc.). • Entrenamiento inicial y documentación breve para que pueda ajustar nuevas FAQs. • Pruebas funcionen en español con casos reales y demostración de la derivación a humano. • Breve guía de mantenimiento y soporte para los primeros ajustes. Si tienes experiencia previa creando chatbots o integraciones en WhatsApp y puedes trabajar con la información no estructurada que describo, me encantará conocer tu enfoque y tiempo estimado.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40808882, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 8 - 15.

opportunities.title: Welcoming Front Yard Design
opportunities.description: I want to transform my front yard into a warm, inviting entryway with a clear, attractive walkway that boosts curb appeal yet stays easy to maintain. An automatic watering system needs to be integrated from the start, with zones sized for future plant growth and a user-friendly controller. I’m open to your ideas on hardy, low-upkeep planting palettes and bed materials—as long as they reinforce the welcoming feel and tie in with the house’s style. Deliverables • Scaled site plan detailing walkway alignment, planting beds, hardscape materials, and irrigation layout • Plant schedule listing quantities, sizes, and key seasonal notes • Specification sheet for the automatic watering system (controller, valves, sprinkler or drip type) • Two to three perspective renderings or a SketchUp/3D view that shows the new entry experience • Concise maintenance guide so I know how to keep everything looking sharp Please supply finals as print-ready PDFs plus the editable source files (DWG, SKP, or similar). Let me know your usual turnaround and anything you need from me—measurements, photos, utility maps—so we can kick this off right away.

opportunities.title: Job Search and Application Specialist
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Job Search & Application Specialist – 10+ Targeted Job Applications Daily (Remote) NOTE: You will be applying to 50+ job positions a week. They weekly amount will be $50. DO NOT BID more than $50 per week as you will not be considered. **Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time / Long-Term **Work Location:** Remote **Experience Level:** Intermediate **Compensation:** Open to hourly or fixed weekly rates **Daily Target:** Minimum 10 completed, highly relevant job applications ## Job Overview I am looking for a dependable, detail-oriented freelancer to manage my daily job search and application process. I am an experienced cybersecurity executive, technical leader, and software developer with over 20 years of professional experience. My background includes cybersecurity engineering, penetration testing, application security, AI-powered automation, cloud technologies, product development, and technology leadership. I have already prepared structured JSON files containing my professional experience, technical skills, certifications, target job titles, and eight AI prompts designed to tailor résumés and cover letters. **Your job is not to write my professional background from scratch. Your job is to use the information and tools I provide to find highly relevant opportunities, customize each application, and submit at least 10 quality applications every business day.** I am not interested in someone sending the same generic résumé to hundreds of random jobs. Relevance, accuracy, and quality are extremely important. ## What You Will Do Every Day ### 1. Find Relevant Job Opportunities Search LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Dice, company career websites, and other appropriate job boards. Use my provided `target_job_titles.json` file to identify suitable positions. Target opportunities in areas including: - Cybersecurity Engineering and Architecture - Application Security and Product Security - Penetration Testing and Offensive Security - AI Engineering and AI Security - DevSecOps and Security Automation - Cloud Security and Infrastructure - Security Software Engineering - Technical Product Management - Cybersecurity Leadership and Consulting - CTO, CISO, and other appropriate senior technical roles **Job requirements:** - Remote positions based in the United States. - Strong alignment with my actual professional experience. - Preferably posted within the previous 7 days. - Compensation aligned with the salary preferences provided in my profile. - No roles requiring relocation, regular on-site attendance, or sponsorship. - Avoid entry-level opportunities or positions clearly outside my background. - Avoid staffing agency duplicates and previously submitted applications. A job should meet approximately 80% or more of its essential qualifications before being considered for application. This is a practical screening guideline, not permission to disregard mandatory requirements. ### 2. Evaluate Each Job Before Applying Review the complete job description and compare it against my `user_profile.json`. Identify: - Required technical skills and certifications. - Relevant experience from my career. - Seniority and leadership expectations. - Mandatory versus preferred qualifications. - Remote work eligibility and location restrictions. - Salary range, when available. **Do not apply if the position is clearly unsuitable, even if the title matches one of my target job titles.** ### 3. Customize My Résumé Using AI Use ChatGPT, Claude, or a comparable AI tool along with my supplied `job_alignment_prompts.json` file. The prompts cover: 1. Spot the Flaws 2. Rewrite for Impact 3. ATS Boost 4. Craft My Hook 5. Upgrade Experience 6. Format Fix 7. Tailor for the Role 8. Standout Cover Letter For each suitable job: - Review the job description. - Tailor the professional summary to the position. - Highlight the most relevant technical experience. - Incorporate applicable industry keywords naturally. - Emphasize achievements, leadership, and technical accomplishments. - Generate a professional, ATS-friendly PDF résumé. - Prepare a customized cover letter when requested or beneficial. **Important:** You must never invent certifications, employment history, qualifications, accomplishments, or performance metrics. All application information must be supported by my provided professional profile. ### 4. Complete and Submit Applications Apply directly through the employer's website or an appropriate job platform. Complete all required application fields accurately using the provided profile. Upload the tailored résumé and cover letter when applicable. You must: - Answer screening questions accurately. - Check all information before submission. - Avoid duplicate applications. - Never provide fabricated information. - Never change salary, location, work authorization, or other personal preferences without permission. - Flag questions requiring my personal judgment rather than guessing. **A job application only counts toward the daily target after it has been successfully submitted.** ### 5. Maintain a Daily Application Tracker Maintain a shared Google Sheet containing: | Field | Required | |---|---| | Application Date | Yes | | Company Name | Yes | | Job Title | Yes | | Job Posting URL | Yes | | Salary Range | If available | | Relevance Score | Yes | | Application Status | Yes | | Résumé Version Used | Yes | | Cover Letter Used | Yes | | Submission Confirmation | Yes | | Follow-Up Date | When applicable | | Notes | Yes | Record applications as they are submitted, not at the end of the week. Save copies of customized résumés and cover letters in organized folders so they can be reused or reviewed later. ## Daily Performance Requirements **Minimum: 10 successfully submitted, highly relevant applications per business day.** Expected output: - 50 or more completed applications per five-day workweek. - Customized résumés for each submitted application. - Customized cover letters where appropriate. - Accurate and complete application tracking. - No duplicate applications. - No fabricated qualifications. - Daily status report. If fewer than 10 genuinely qualified opportunities are available, report the shortfall and explain why. Do not submit weak applications simply to reach the quota. ## Required Skills You should have experience with: - LinkedIn, Indeed, and other professional job platforms. - Job searching and résumé tailoring. - Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). - ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools. - Google Sheets and Google Drive. - Professional English communication. - Handling confidential personal information. Previous experience applying for US-based cybersecurity, cloud engineering, software engineering, or senior IT positions is strongly preferred. You do not need to be a cybersecurity engineer, but you must be able to understand technical job descriptions well enough to distinguish relevant positions from irrelevant ones. ## Files and Tools Provided I will provide: - `user_profile.json` — My verified professional background, employment history, skills, certifications, and application preferences. - `target_job_titles.json` — Job titles to search. - `job_alignment_prompts.json` — AI instructions for tailoring résumés and cover letters. - Existing résumé/CV documents. - Access to an approved AI-assisted document workflow. - A shared Google Sheet for tracking applications. I will also provide any necessary application preferences and an approved method for handling account access. ## How Success Will Be Measured Performance will be evaluated based on: **1. Job relevance:** Are the opportunities genuinely appropriate for my qualifications? **2. Application quality:** Are the résumés properly tailored, accurate, and professionally formatted? **3. Daily output:** Are at least 10 qualified applications submitted per business day? **4. Accuracy:** Are all application details correct and supported by my profile? **5. Organization:** Is every application documented and verifiable? **6. Responsiveness:** Are application issues, recruiter responses, and questions escalated promptly? Interview invitations and recruiter responses will also be monitored, although they are not guaranteed outcomes. ## Paid Trial Assignment Selected candidates will complete a paid one-day trial. During the trial, you will: 1. Review the three supplied JSON files. 2. Identify 15 highly relevant job opportunities. 3. Rank them according to suitability. 4. Customize résumés for the 5 best opportunities. 5. Explain why each position is a strong match. 6. Submit applications only after receiving approval. 7. Record the results in the application tracker. Candidates who demonstrate strong judgment, accuracy, and efficiency will be considered for ongoing work. ## How to Apply for This Freelance Position Please answer these five questions in your proposal: 1. How many targeted US-based professional job applications can you realistically complete in a four-hour workday? 2. Have you previously applied for cybersecurity, software engineering, cloud, or senior IT roles on behalf of clients? 3. What is your process for tailoring a résumé to a specific job description using ChatGPT or another AI tool? 4. How do you prevent duplicate applications and verify successful submissions? 5. What is your proposed weekly rate for 50 completed, high-quality job applications? **Please start your proposal with the phrase "Targeted Applications" so I know you read the full job description.** I am looking for a reliable, long-term working relationship with someone who prioritizes quality and consistency over mass applications.

opportunities.title: MEP Engineer Needed for Design -- 2
opportunities.description: I have a new construction project moving into the design phase and I need a qualified MEP engineer to take charge of the mechanical, electrical and plumbing plans. At this stage I have architectural PDFs and a preliminary structural layout; what I’m missing is a coordinated MEP package that my builder and the local authority can rely on. Scope • Review the architectural and structural files I provide (DWG and PDF). • Develop properly coordinated mechanical, electrical and plumbing layouts—including equipment schedules, load calculations and single-line diagrams—so everything fits both spatially and technically. • Produce drawings ready for permit submission as well as clean construction-issue sets in AutoCAD or Revit, plus PDFs. • Remain available for one revision round after the first review to resolve any comments from the municipality or my GC. Acceptance criteria • All drawings follow the latest local code references I will supply. • Files are delivered in native CAD/Revit format and PDF. • Clash-free coordination among M, E and P disciplines. If your background covers full-cycle MEP design and you are comfortable collaborating remotely—screen-shares, quick calls, marked-up PDFs—please let me know your typical turnaround time and any comparable projects you have completed.

opportunities.title: Highway Retail Lighting Design in DIALux
opportunities.description: Job Title DIALux Evo Lighting Designer – Commercial Highway Retail Outlet (NH16, India) Project Overview We require a highly qualified freelance Electrical Engineer / Lighting Designer to create a comprehensive, data-driven outdoor and canopy lighting design for a commercial retail outlet located along the National Highways Authority of India (NH16) corridor. The property sits adjacent to an elevated highway flyover and features a deep 27-meter setback between the highway edge and the primary commercial structures. The primary goal of this design is two-fold: uncompromising operational safety and high-impact visual marketing to attract fast-moving traffic from the elevated overbridge. Scope of Work & Technical Deliverables The freelancer must build a complete simulation model in DIALux Evo (Version 12 or newer) using exact site dimensions. We are not looking for a generic layout technician; we require a true design engineering process that delivers: 1. 3D Elevation Line-of-Sight Mapping: You must utilize Google Earth Pro 3D terrain/elevation data to accurately plot the driver's downward viewing angle from the crest of the adjacent elevated flyover (estimated height variance: 6.5m to 7.5m above our ground level) down to our property entryway. 2. Setback Transition Engineering: Design a seamless lighting runway across the 27-meter dark setback void using highly targeted Asymmetric Optic Floodlights to ensure uniform safety without throwing illegal blinding glare into the eyes of highway traffic. 3. High-Uniformity Canopy Profiling: The main canopy and sales forecourt must be engineered to a clean, dense 200+ Lux target, serving as a solid, high-contrast visual beacon against the bright ambient light barrier of the highway's existing street lighting. 4. Local Subcontinent Procurement Alignment: You are strictly prohibited from using default European or American lighting fixture libraries built into DIALux. The entire project must be simulated using official, verified IES/LDT photometric files downloaded directly from current Indian manufacturing catalogs (e.g., Crompton Spectacle/Tango series, Philips, Bajaj, or Havells). 5. Data Documentation Required: • Full DIALux PDF Engineering Report. • Isoline / Lux Contour Plot Map showing exact light gradients across the concrete pad. • Pseudo-Color Renderings demonstrating strict mathematical color codes for lux distribution (rather than just "pretty" aesthetic 3D pictures). • Final native .evo project file. Required Qualifications • Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering (B.Tech / BE / AMIE). • Proven portfolio demonstrating successful outdoor infrastructure, highway, parking yard, or large-scale industrial facility design (residences, offices, and pure interior design portfolios will be automatically rejected). • Deep familiarity with Indian electrical codes, high-ambient urban light barriers, and localized equipment durability factors (e.g., managing dust, grit, and high-wind environments). • Must include at least two (2) rounds of revision within the bid to accommodate on-ground structural pole modifications if required during construction.

opportunities.title: Editor de Video y Músico para Raven Ruin Sessions (Guitar Covers)
opportunities.description: Se busca un editor de video en Da Vinci Resolve o Adobe Premiere con habilidades musicales para la postproducción de "RAVEN Ruin Sessions", una serie de videos de covers de guitarra. El proyecto implica la edición de múltiples tomas de video grabadas con tres cámaras simultáneamente (edición multicámara), así como la sincronización y edición de audio. Requisitos del proyecto: - Edición multicámara: Cada sesión incluye numerosas tomas (hasta 18), con cada toma capturada desde tres ángulos distintos. - Sincronización de audio y video: El audio se graba en vivo en Logic Pro. El cliente realizará el "comping" de audio, seleccionando los mejores momentos, y el editor deberá usar este mapa para la edición de video. Es crucial que los solos de guitarra coincidan exactamente con la toma de audio, mientras que en otras partes no críticas (como los riffs), se permite cierta flexibilidad para priorizar la energía y la actuación visual. - Edición creativa y dinámica: Se espera un enfoque creativo que sirva al estilo y la energía de la música. El editor deberá utilizar zooms dinámicos y movimientos de cámara estratégicos para mantener la atención de la audiencia y realzar la interpretación. - Postproducción de pantalla verde (Chroma Key): Las interpretaciones se graban frente a una pantalla verde. El editor será responsable de aplicar el chroma key de manera natural e integrar el contenido de fondo para que se vea orgánico y no "pegado". El objetivo es encontrar un profesional que no solo demuestre habilidad técnica, sino que también entienda la visión artística y la energía de cada canción, contribuyendo a un producto final pulido y atractivo para la audiencia. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Edición de video existente

opportunities.title: Modélisation 3D monoplace fidèle
opportunities.description: Je souhaite obtenir un fichier 3D parfaitement fidèle à mon prototype de monoplace pour une impression d’environ 20 cm de long. Ce que je fournis • Un jeu complet de photos sous tous les angles. • Un premier modèle généré via Meshy AI (format .obj) qui sert de base, mais manque encore de précision. Mon besoin • Reprendre ou repartir du modèle existant afin de reproduire chaque détail visible sur les photos : carrosserie, prises d’air, cockpit, rainures, écrous, logos, etc. • Optimiser la géométrie et l’épaisseur des parois pour une impression propre sans supports excessifs. • Garder l’ensemble en une seule pièce autant que possible ; je n’envisage pas d’assemblage séparé pour les roues ou les ailerons. • Remettre un fichier prêt à imprimer (STL ou OBJ + orientation conseillée). Points d’attention – La silhouette et les proportions doivent correspondre à la réalité à 100 %. – Les détails fins (ouïes, aérodynamique, petits reliefs) doivent rester visibles après une mise à l’échelle 20 cm. – Ma machine accepte des tolérances standard FDM ; merci d’éviter les parois inférieures à 0,8 mm. Livrables attendus 1. Fichier final optimisé (STL ou OBJ). 2. Capture ou rendu rapide montrant l’ajustement final. 3. Courte note sur les paramètres d’impression conseillés (buse, résolution, supports). Idéalement vous maîtrisez Blender, ZBrush ou Fusion 360 et avez déjà finalisé des modèles pour l’impression 3D. Si vous avez des exemples de projets similaires, je serai ravi de les voir.

opportunities.title: Lead-Generating Civil Engineering Website
opportunities.description: I need a clean, fully responsive website that turns visitors into qualified enquiries for our civil engineering firm. The single most important outcome is to encourage prospects to request a site visit, so every design choice should steer them toward that action while presenting our company history and values with clarity and authority. The build must look sharp on desktop, tablet, and mobile, load fast, and be search-engine friendly. A modern CMS—WordPress, Webflow, or a comparable platform—will let my team update text and add new projects without coding. Integrate an intuitive “Request a Site Visit” form or scheduling widget that emails our office and stores entries in the back-end for easy follow-up. Deliverables • Custom design and front-end development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap or equivalent) • CMS setup with reusable templates for future pages • On-page SEO basics, Google Analytics, and essential security hardening • Handoff package: style guide, editable files, and a brief video or PDF showing how to manage content Acceptance criteria 1. Pages render flawlessly across major browsers and common screen sizes 2. Site-visit request workflow sends notifications and logs data reliably 3. Core pages load in under three seconds on a 4G mobile connection 4. I can edit menus, text, and images without developer assistance Please share a realistic timeline; a clickable draft within two weeks of kickoff would be ideal.

opportunities.title: Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer for Engaging Finance Interviews
opportunities.description: Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer for Financial Education Interviews Budget: €60–€120 per interview (fixed price) Initial project: 2 interviews Potential for ongoing collaboration Project Overview: We are NextGen Finance Academy, a financial education initiative dedicated to making finance, investing, and financial literacy accessible to younger generations. We have recently recorded two interviews with experienced professionals from the financial industry, including Harlan Hodes from Franklin Templeton and Miguel Pohl. We are looking for a creative and reliable video editor who can transform our raw interview footage into professional, visually engaging, and educational YouTube videos. Our target audience consists primarily of teenagers and young adults aged 14–22. Many viewers will have limited financial knowledge, so our goal is to make complex concepts easy to understand without compromising the professionalism of the interviews. We want the final videos to feel like modern educational YouTube content rather than traditional, static corporate interviews. 1. Video Editing and Post-Production: The selected freelancer will be responsible for editing the interview footage into a polished final video. This includes: - Removing unnecessary pauses, awkward silences, technical interruptions, and repeated sentences. - Cutting irrelevant sections while preserving the natural flow of the conversation. - Improving pacing to maintain audience engagement. - Applying basic color correction for a clean, consistent appearance. - Cleaning up background noise and improving dialogue clarity. - Balancing audio levels throughout the interview. - Adding subtle zooms, transitions, and visual changes where appropriate. - Maintaining synchronisation between audio and video. The final result should look professional, natural, and engaging. We do not want excessive transitions, distracting effects, or unnecessarily aggressive editing. 2. Educational Animations and Motion Graphics: This is one of the most important aspects of the project. We want the editor to incorporate simple but engaging animations that help explain financial concepts mentioned during the interviews. For example: Compound Interest If an interviewee discusses compound interest, we would like to see a simple animated chart showing how an initial investment grows over time. Stock Market Investing When discussing shares, the editor could incorporate animated stock charts, company icons, or simple visual representations of buying and selling shares. Risk and Diversification If portfolio diversification is mentioned, an animated portfolio could demonstrate how investments are distributed across different asset classes. Financial Careers When discussing career progression, a simple animated timeline could illustrate the different stages of a career in finance. These are examples only. The actual animations should correspond to the topics discussed in the interviews. Animation Requirements - Approximately 2 simple animated explanations per interview. - Clean 2D animations, charts, diagrams, icons, and text-based motion graphics. - Animations should be understandable to viewers without previous financial knowledge. - Visuals should complement the speaker’s explanation rather than interrupt it. - Template-based animations are acceptable. - Complex 3D animation is not required. - All financial figures and explanations must be accurate and approved before publication. We are particularly interested in editors who can combine interview footage with animated explanations in a seamless and entertaining way. 3. B-Roll and Supporting Visuals: To prevent the videos from becoming visually repetitive, we would like relevant supporting visuals throughout the interviews. These may include: - Financial markets and trading environments. - Business and investment-related imagery. - Relevant charts and graphs. - Company logos where appropriate. - Financial news headlines, when relevant and accurately sourced. - Simple animated text highlighting important statements. All third-party footage, music, and graphics must be appropriately licensed for online publication. We want the videos to feel dynamic without becoming overly flashy. 4. Visual Identity and Branding: The videos should follow NextGen Finance Academy’s visual identity. Our preferred colors are: - Dark navy blue. - White. - Grey. - Subtle complementary colors where necessary. We prefer a modern, minimalistic, and professional aesthetic. The freelancer should incorporate: - A simple branded introduction. - Clean lower-thirds identifying the interviewer and guest. - Consistent typography. - Subtle transitions. - A branded outro. We can provide our logo and relevant branding materials. 5. Social Media Content For each interview, we would also like one short vertical video suitable for: - Instagram Reels. - YT Shorts. - TikTok. Specifications: - Duration: Approximately 30–60 seconds. - Aspect ratio: 9:16. - Clear, readable captions. - Engaging opening hook. - Dynamic but professional editing. - A memorable insight or valuable lesson from the interview. The short should encourage viewers to watch the full interview. 6. Deliverables For each interview, the freelancer should provide: 1. One fully edited, professional interview video. 2. Two simple animated explanations of financial concepts. 3. Basic audio enhancement and color correction. 4. Relevant B-roll and supporting visuals. 5. Branded introduction, lower-thirds, and outro. 6. One vertical social media highlight video. 7. Final exports in MP4 format, 1080p minimum. 8. Up to two reasonable rounds of revisions. We will provide the raw interview footage and branding materials. The exact interview duration and footage requirements will be confirmed before the project begins. 7. Budget and Payment Our budget is €60–€120 per completed interview. We understand this is a limited budget and are not expecting advanced cinematic production or complex custom animations. We are looking for an editor who can achieve high-quality results using efficient editing techniques, simple motion graphics, and reusable templates. We would prefer to begin with one interview before commissioning the second. If the collaboration is successful, we would be interested in working with the same editor on future interviews and educational videos. 8. Ideal Freelancer We are looking for someone with: - Experience editing interviews, podcasts, or YouTube videos. - Basic motion graphics and animation skills. - Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, After Effects, or equivalent software. - Strong English comprehension. - Good visual storytelling skills. - Attention to detail. - Reliable communication and respect for deadlines. Experience creating financial or educational content would be an advantage. 9. Application Instructions When applying, please include: 1. A brief introduction about your editing experience. 2. Two or three examples of previous interview or podcast editing projects. 3. At least one example of motion graphics or animated educational content. 4. Your proposed fixed price per interview. 5. Your estimated turnaround time. 6. The editing software you use. Please also briefly explain how you would make a financial interview engaging for a teenage audience. We will prioritize candidates who demonstrate creativity, clear communication, and a strong understanding of educational storytelling. Our Vision We believe financial education should be accessible, entertaining, and understandable to everyone, regardless of their background or previous knowledge. Through these interviews, we want young people to learn directly from experienced professionals while enjoying content that is visually engaging and easy to follow. We are looking for someone who can help us bring that vision to life. NextGen Finance Academy

opportunities.title: 3D-printable CAD model of WHOOP 5.0 sensor body (WS50) – accurate strap hinge required
opportunities.description: I need an accurate 3D model of the WHOOP 5.0 sensor body (model WS50), exactly as shown in the attached photo, at real size. The model WILL BE 3D PRINTED, so it must be designed for printing (see below). Overall size: 34.7 x 24 x 10.6 mm (L x W x H), published spec. I will confirm with calipers and send my measurements; use my measurements where they differ. MOST IMPORTANT – THE STRAP HINGE: The strap connection must be dimensionally accurate. That means the raised stepped block at the end where the strap clips in, the groove along the bottom edge, and the small hole at the other end. The printed part must click into the real WHOOP strap just like the original device. Tolerance on these features: ±0.1 mm. My caliper measurements: - Hinge block: width __ mm, height __ mm, depth __ mm, step height __ mm - Groove: width __ mm, depth __ mm, length __ mm - Hole: diameter __ mm, distance from end __ mm MUST BE 3D-PRINTABLE: - Printer: FDM, 0.4 mm nozzle, PLA+ / PETG - Clean, watertight (manifold) STL: no holes, no inverted or zero-thickness faces - Minimum wall thickness 1.2 mm; no feature thinner than 0.8 mm - Flat bottom face that sits on the print bed - Hinge designed to print with no supports or minimal supports; use chamfers instead of fillets on downward-facing edges where possible - Hinge clearance as an editable parameter (default 0.15 mm) so I can tune the fit after test prints - Tell me the best print orientation Other requirements: - Units in mm, 1:1 real scale - Match the outer shape: curved top, flat bottom, rounded edges and chamfers - Solid outer body only (no electronics or internal parts) - No text, logos or engraving needed Deliverables: - Parametric SolidWorks file (.SLDPRT) – required - STEP + STL files - A screenshot showing the key dimensions I will test-print the model. If it doesn't print cleanly or the hinge doesn't fit the strap, you fix it (2 revisions included). Budget: $5 fixed. Please only bid if you are OK with $5. No counter-offers

opportunities.title: Build Three Production-Ready AI SaaS Platforms
opportunities.description: HIRING: SENIOR AI FULL-STACK DEVELOPER / SOFTWARE ARCHITECT / DEVELOPMENT TEAM — THREE COMPLETE PRODUCTION-READY SaaS PLATFORMS COMPANY: NEVIE-GLOBAL (France). PROPOSED TOTAL FIXED PRICE: USD $750, subject to written acceptance. CONTRACT: full delivery, verified milestones, long-term technical partnership. We seek an experienced senior engineer or small multidisciplinary team to finish, secure, test, deploy and hand over THREE independent commercial SaaS platforms. NOT prototypes, MVPs, static dashboards, demos or partial deliverables. Existing specifications and code must be audited, verified, corrected and reused when appropriate. Every promised feature requires reproducible evidence and a written acceptance criterion. 1. AI AGENT & AVATAR FACTORY — COMPLETE PRODUCT: Secure multi-tenant SaaS with a target catalogue of 502 DISTINCT, working, documented and individually tested AI agent/avatar references. Consumer packages: 4, 8 or 12 agents, each with one supervisor. Professional packages: 12 agents + 1 supervisor + 1 AI Architect; 24 agents + 3 supervisors + 1 AI Architect; 60 agents + 5 supervisors + 1 AI Architect. Support creation, onboarding, activation, execution, supervision, pausing, versioning, updating and safe shutdown of agents; text, supported voice and visual avatars; model-provider APIs, RAG and document knowledge bases. Business functions: lead generation, prospect scoring, sales assistance, CRM synchronization, email drafting/approved sending, WhatsApp Business, appointment booking, calendars, support/tickets, quotes, invoicing, marketing campaigns, social media content/approved publishing, document workflows, website audits, reporting and industry-specific processes. Commercial functions: bilingual FR/EN public site and catalogue, self-service customer onboarding, organizations, roles, secure authentication, plan selection, checkout, subscription changes, invoices, customer/admin dashboards, usage quotas, metering, cost alerts, payment integration, integration permissions, audit trails, logs, backups, recovery and strict tenant isolation. 2. AI FACTORY BUILDER — COMPLETE INDEPENDENT PRODUCT: Convert a customer’s natural-language request into a genuinely operational AI team. Tôi mong muốn có ít nhất một vòng chỉnh sửa sau khi nhận bản đầu tiên. opportunities.title: Medspa Pilot Sales Partner Needed
opportunities.description: Freelance Sales & Pilot Acquisition Partner — Agenzo Agenzo is looking for a performance-based freelance sales partner to help us acquire our first few pilot customers in the US medspa and aesthetic clinic market. What you'll do - Research and identify qualified medspas and aesthetic clinics. - Reach out to clinic owners, founders, and decision-makers. - Set up sales/discovery meetings with qualified prospects. - Join the meetings with me and actively help present Agenzo. - Help handle objections, communicate the value proposition, and move qualified prospects toward a pilot. - Follow up with prospects after meetings and help drive deals toward closing. - Work closely with me throughout the entire sales process. Compensation This is a 100% performance-based opportunity with no fixed salary. You will receive 20% commission on the pilot payment actually received by Agenzo for every pilot customer you directly help acquire and close. Commission is paid only after: 1. The customer agrees to the pilot. 2. The customer has completed the required agreement/onboarding. 3. Agenzo has received the customer's full pilot payment. There is no commission for simply booking a meeting or generating a lead. If the initial meetings go exceptionally well and I feel we're a strong fit to work together, the commission percentage can be increased based on performance and future responsibilities. Ideal candidate - Strong B2B sales/outbound experience. - Comfortable speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience selling SaaS, AI, automation, healthcare technology, or similar products is a strong advantage. - Excellent communication and objection-handling skills. - Strong spoken English. - US B2B sales experience is highly preferred. - Self-motivated and comfortable working on a performance-only basis. Why join Agenzo? You'll work directly with the founder rather than simply handing off leads. You'll be involved in the actual sales conversations, demos, objection handling, and closing process. If you're good at what you do, there is significant room for the relationship to grow as Agenzo scales. The goal is simple: find the right clinics, get them into the conversation, help close the pilot, and earn when the customer actually pays.

opportunities.title: Creative 2D Animation Production
opportunities.description: I need a polished 2-D animation from concept through final render. The scope is intentionally open: style, length, and storytelling approach can be proposed by you as long as the end result is visually engaging, smoothly animated, and delivered in a high-quality video format (MP4 or MOV) together with the editable project files. You will work from any reference material I provide and suggest a storyboard, rough animatic, clean animation, and final sound-synced cut. I’ll give clear, timely feedback at each stage so revisions stay efficient and focused. Final deliverables • Completed HD or 4K video file • Source files (PSD/AI, After Effects, Toon Boom, or other native files used) • Any music or SFX licenses you secure on my behalf Please include links to comparable 2-D work and note your preferred software pipeline.

opportunities.title: Multilingual 3D Cartoon Pilot Animation
opportunities.description: AI-Assisted 3D Cartoon Animation for Multilingual Children’s Educational Series Budget: €800–€1,200 | Fixed Price Project Description We are looking for a talented freelancer or small animation studio to create a high-quality, AI-assisted 3D-style cartoon pilot for an upcoming international children’s educational project. The videos will be designed for children aged 3–6. Our goal is to develop a professional animated series that can later be adapted into multiple languages and distributed internationally. We are looking for a creative partner interested in long-term collaboration. Pilot Episode Requirements * Duration: 60–90 seconds * High-quality, colorful, child-friendly 3D cartoon style * Two original animated animal characters * Consistent character appearance across all scenes * Natural movements, facial expressions and simple lip-sync * Professional voice-over in two languages * Background music and sound effects with commercial usage rights * Full HD (1920 × 1080), MP4 format * One revision round included Important: Multilingual Expansion The series is intended to expand into multiple languages in the future. The production workflow must therefore allow: * Reusing the same characters and animation assets across different language versions * Replacing voice-overs without recreating the entire video * Adjusting lip-sync for different languages where needed * Creating additional episodes with consistent character designs * Adding new characters and languages in future seasons * Delivering reusable project files and character assets where technically possible We are looking for a scalable and cost-effective production solution. Required Skills * AI-assisted animation and 3D cartoon production * Consistent character design * Experience with Runway, Kling, Blender or similar tools * Multilingual voice-over integration * Video editing and sound design * Experience producing children’s content is preferred Please Include in Your Proposal 1. Examples of similar animation projects. 2. Your fixed price for the pilot episode. 3. Estimated delivery time. 4. Which tools and workflow you recommend. 5. How you would maintain character consistency across future episodes. 6. Whether existing animations can be reused for additional languages. 7. The estimated cost of creating an additional language version. 8. The estimated cost of producing additional episodes. 9. Which commercial usage rights, character assets and editable project files are included. 10. Whether you can also assist with website integration and online publishing. Confidentiality The full project concept, character names, scripts and business details are confidential and will only be shared with shortlisted candidates after signing a non-disclosure agreement (NDA). We would like to begin with a small paid animation test before commissioning the complete pilot episode. We are interested in a reliable long-term production partner. Please send your portfolio, proposed workflow and fixed-price quotation.

Required Skills * AI-assisted animation and 3D cartoon production * Consistent character design * Experience with Runway, Kling, Blender or similar tools * Multilingual voice-over integration * Video editing and sound design * Experience producing children’s content is preferred Please Include in Your Proposal 1. opportunities.title: Aplikasi Manajemen Tugas Multi-Tim
opportunities.description: Saya ingin mempercepat dan mempermudah cara kami mengatur tugas serta jadwal untuk banyak staf yang bekerja di beberapa tim. Saat ini semuanya masih di-excel dan grup chat, sehingga sering terlambat dan sulit dilacak. Saya membutuhkan sebuah platform terpusat di mana setiap orang bisa: • Menerima penugasan dengan tenggat dan prioritas yang jelas. • Melihat kalender tim yang otomatis sinkron ketika ada perubahan. • Menerima notifikasi instan (email, push, atau WhatsApp) saat ada tugas baru atau jadwal bergeser. • Melaporkan progres secara real-time sehingga manajer dapat memantau beban kerja dan tenggat yang terlewat. • Beroperasi dengan hak akses bertingkat (admin, leader, anggota) agar data tetap aman antar-tim. • Mengekspor laporan ke Excel/CSV untuk rekap bulanan. Preferensi teknis: – Boleh web-based dengan tampilan mobile-friendly; opsi aplikasi native ringan juga dipertimbangkan. – Dapat di-hosting di server Linux kami atau cloud umum. – Antarmuka harus cukup intuitif untuk dipelajari dalam ±15 menit oleh pengguna non-teknis. Deliverable yang saya harapkan: 1. Prototype fungsional (front-end & back-end) siap uji coba. 2. Dokumentasi instalasi serta panduan pengguna singkat. 3. Kode sumber lengkap untuk kami kembangkan lebih lanjut. Pengalaman membangun sistem serupa dengan stack populer (Laravel, Node.js, React, Flutter, dsb.) menjadi nilai tambah. Sertakan contoh proyek relevan ketika mengajukan penawaran.

Semua kontak pelanggan sudah tersedia; Anda tinggal mengelola dan menjaga kerahasiaannya. Pengalaman dengan fitur label, quick reply, dan tool bulk messaging WhatsApp Business akan sangat membantu. Cantumkan contoh copy promosi yang pernah Anda buat atau jelaskan strategi follow-up Anda. Apabila performa bagus, proyek ini dapat berlanjut sebagai kerja sama jangka panjang.

opportunities.title: Build AI B2B Market Intelligence Platform
opportunities.description: # Job Title **Senior Python Data Engineer & AI Business Intelligence Platform Developer — B2B Market Intelligence, Data Pipelines & AI** ## About Our Business Vidya Timber is a family-owned plywood, timber and interior materials business based in Varanasi, India. We are expanding into modular interiors and developing our premium architectural door brand, Archwood. We are looking to build an AI-powered B2B Market Intelligence Platform that helps our sales team discover potential customers, identify construction projects, understand business relationships and prioritize high-value commercial opportunities. We are looking for an experienced technical professional who can build a reliable, scalable and production-ready platform—not just a prototype, chatbot or basic lead-generation tool. ## Project Vision The platform should help us identify: - Architects and architecture firms - Interior designers - Builders and real estate developers - Contractors and construction companies - Plywood, timber and building-material dealers - Publicly announced construction and real estate projects The long-term objective is to transform publicly available business intelligence into actionable sales opportunities for Vidya Timber and Archwood. ## Core Responsibilities ### 1. B2B Business Intelligence Data Collection - Develop reliable data pipelines using Python. - Collect publicly available business information from relevant sources. - Explore sources such as Google Maps, company websites, project portfolios, public RERA records, government project announcements, news publications and business directories. - Discover construction projects in Varanasi and Uttar Pradesh, including projects not yet listed on RERA. - Maintain source URLs, discovery dates and verification status for collected records. - Implement deduplication, data cleaning and enrichment workflows. - Respect website terms, applicable laws, privacy requirements and data access restrictions. ### 2. Database & Data Engineering - Design a structured PostgreSQL database. - Build relationships between companies, people, projects and business activities. - Implement data validation and quality checks. - Maintain a reliable data ingestion and update process. - Design the system for future expansion across multiple cities and states. ### 3. AI-Powered Intelligence - Use LLMs for extracting structured information from public sources. - Implement AI-assisted company enrichment and opportunity identification. - Develop transparent lead scoring based on business relevance and evidence. - Generate actionable reports explaining why a prospect is valuable. - Explore RAG, GraphRAG and AI agents where they provide measurable value. **Important:** We do not want unnecessary AI complexity. The developer should recommend the right architecture based on actual business requirements. ### 4. Working Business Intelligence Dashboard Develop a functional web application that allows our sales team to: - Search and filter prospects. - View company profiles and associated projects. - Understand relationships between architects, builders and contractors. - View lead scores with explanations. - See original source references. - Record calls, follow-ups, notes and sales outcomes. - Export prospect data to CSV or Excel. - Identify the next recommended sales action. ### 5. AI Agents & Future Integrations The platform should eventually support: - Scheduled intelligence collection. - AI-assisted research workflows. - CRM integrations. - Sales reporting. - MCP server integrations where useful. - Automated business opportunity alerts. ## Preferred Technical Skills **Essential:** - Python - PostgreSQL - Data engineering and ETL pipelines - Web data extraction using appropriate tools such as Scrapy or Playwright - API development using FastAPI or similar - Data cleaning, matching, deduplication and validation - Full-stack dashboard development - Production deployment and documentation **Preferred:** - LLM integrations: Claude, OpenAI or Gemini - LangGraph or similar workflow orchestration - RAG and GraphRAG - Knowledge graphs - MCP servers - n8n - Cloud deployment: AWS, GCP or equivalent - B2B lead generation and business intelligence systems ## Initial Scope — 30-Day MVP We want to begin with Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. The first phase should deliver: 1. A working PostgreSQL database. 2. A structured database of relevant local businesses. 3. Source-backed company and project records. 4. A basic relationship mapping system. 5. Transparent lead scoring. 6. A functional sales dashboard. 7. Prospect search, filtering and follow-up tracking. 8. CSV/Excel export. 9. A documented data collection and validation pipeline. 10. A live demonstration of the working platform. We expect a phased approach. The first milestone should be a focused pilot before expanding the system. ## Deliverables - Complete source code. - Database schema and data models. - Working dashboard and backend. - Data collection and enrichment pipelines. - AI workflows, if applicable. - Deployment configuration. - Technical documentation. - Setup instructions. - Testing and validation. - Project handover. All project-specific source code, databases, documentation and deliverables must be owned by Vidya Timber. Third-party tools and services should be clearly documented. ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: - Has built production-grade data pipelines or business intelligence systems. - Can demonstrate relevant completed projects. - Understands the difference between collecting leads and generating actionable intelligence. - Can explain technical decisions in business terms. - Is capable of working independently. - Is interested in a long-term technical partnership. - Can begin with a paid pilot and scale based on results. We are not looking for someone who only builds basic chatbots, generic CRM systems or AI demos. ## Application Questions Please answer the following questions in your proposal: 1. Describe one production-grade B2B data pipeline or business intelligence platform you have developed. 2. How would you discover construction projects in Varanasi and Uttar Pradesh beyond RERA databases? 3. How would you connect architects, builders, contractors and construction projects in a relational database? 4. Would you recommend GraphRAG for the MVP? Why or why not? 5. How would you estimate the potential demand for doors and interior materials from a construction project? 6. What would you include in a 60-hour pilot? 7. What is your estimated timeline and budget for a 30-day MVP? 8. What would the estimated monthly infrastructure and AI API costs be? 9. Can you demonstrate a working production project? 10. Will you personally develop the system, or will other team members be involved? ## Engagement We prefer a paid initial pilot with clearly defined deliverables and milestones. Successful execution may lead to a long-term engagement involving expansion across Uttar Pradesh and additional AI-powered business intelligence capabilities. Please include your hourly rate, estimated hours, proposed architecture and relevant portfolio links. **Our priority is data quality, actionable business intelligence, reliability and measurable commercial value—not unnecessary technical complexity.**

opportunities.title: Product Research & Sourcing Executive
opportunities.description: You need a Full-Time Product Research & Procurement Executive for your Bangalore business. This person will be responsible for finding winning products across India, researching manufacturers, negotiating prices, and getting products delivered to your store. Job Description – Product Research & Sourcing Executive Hiring: Product Research & Sourcing Executive **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka\ **Job Type:** Full-Time | Work from Office About the Role We are looking for a dedicated Product Research & Sourcing Executive who can identify high-potential, trending, and profitable products across India and manage the complete product sourcing process from research to store delivery. Key Responsibilities **1. Daily Product Research** - Research new and trending products across all categories in India. - Identify winning products with high demand and strong sales potential. - Research products trending on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Instagram, YouTube, and other marketplaces. - Analyze product demand, competition, selling prices, customer reviews, and profit margins. - Identify products suitable for our business and customer base. **2. Manufacturer & Supplier Research** - Find genuine manufacturers, factories, and wholesale suppliers across India. - Contact manufacturers directly through phone, WhatsApp, and other channels. - Collect product catalogues, quotations, specifications, and videos. - Negotiate the best manufacturing and wholesale prices. - Verify supplier credibility and product quality. **3. End-to-End Product Procurement** - Coordinate samples and product testing. - Finalize product selection and purchase pricing. - Negotiate minimum order quantities and payment terms. - Arrange transportation from manufacturers to our Bangalore store. - Track orders until products are received at our store. - Maintain supplier and product databases. **4. Product Profitability Analysis** - Calculate total landed cost, including transportation and packaging. - Estimate selling price, marketplace competition, and profit margins. - Recommend only products with strong commercial potential. **5. Daily Reporting** - Submit daily product research reports. - Maintain a list of new products, manufacturers, prices, and estimated margins. - Track sourcing progress and pending supplier discussions. Candidate Requirements - Strong research and communication skills. - Experience in product sourcing, procurement, trading, or e-commerce preferred. - Ability to identify profitable products and market opportunities. - Comfortable speaking with manufacturers and negotiating prices. - Good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets. - Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently. Work Expectations - Full-time employment. - Daily product research and supplier communication. - Pan-India manufacturer and supplier sourcing. - Complete ownership of product research to store delivery. Position Product Research & Sourcing Executive – Full-Time **Apply:** Submit your resume with relevant experience and salary expectations. What I recommend for your business Don't hire someone just for searching products. Hire someone who can find a winning product and bring it all the way to your Bangalore store. Daily targets for this employee | Activity | Daily Target | | ----------------------------- | ------------ | | Research new products | 30–50 | | Shortlist potential products | 5–10 | | Find manufacturers | 5–10 | | Contact suppliers | 10–20 | | Detailed product analysis | 3–5 | | Final product recommendations | 1–2 | Important: Winning Product Research The employee should research products across: - Home & kitchen - Furniture - Toys & kids products - Electronics & accessories - Home improvement - Storage & organization - Lifestyle products - Trending Instagram products - Other high-demand, low-competition products Main objective: Find products that can sell consistently, have good margins, and can be sourced directly from manufacturers at competitive prices. I recommend the designation Product Research, Sourcing & Procurement Manager if you want one person to take complete responsibility for this entire process rather than just research.

opportunities.title: Zoho CRM set-up for a marketplace partner onboarding journey
opportunities.description: We’re building a UK online marketplace. It depends on a steady flow of partner stores, restaurants, takeaways and wholesalers. We need a Zoho set-up that turns every new sign-up into a guided onboarding journey, tracks each partner’s progress in a clear pipeline, and prompts our team automatically at each step. Choosing the right Zoho products We think Zoho CRM on its own may be enough, but we’d like your advice. Please explain whether Zoho Creator or another Zoho app is needed, with the pros, cons, costs and complexity of each option. Please also say which Zoho CRM edition (Standard or Professional) each feature needs. We’ll agree the set-up with you before any configuration begins. What it needs to do A public online sign-up form sends partner details straight into Zoho. When a new partner record is created, the partner gets a branded welcome message and timed reminders. Messages go by WhatsApp or email, depending on each partner’s preferred contact method. Some partners don’t use email. WhatsApp should use Zoho’s own WhatsApp connection with Meta-approved message templates. Onboarding tasks are created and assigned to our team automatically. When a task is completed or a key field is updated, the partner moves to the next stage of a visual pipeline (Blueprint). Clear reports on partner numbers, time from sign-up to going live, and the history of follow-ups. Deliverables A short recommendation on the best Zoho product mix. Modules, fields and pipeline stages set up to match our onboarding steps. Automated emails, WhatsApp messages, tasks and stage moves, fully tested with sample data. One live sign-up form connected to Zoho. A short handover guide plus a screen-share session, so our team can run and maintain the system. How we work The Zoho account is in our company’s name, and we are the main administrator. You’ll get a user login for the project, which we’ll remove at handover. We need a UK/EU data centre and a signed NDA. We won’t share real partner data until both are in place. The work counts as complete when we have tested it and signed it off. Zoho licences are paid by us directly to Zoho, so please leave them out of your quote. We have a written set-up guide describing our fields, stages and messages. We’ll share it with shortlisted freelancers. Your quote Please send: A fixed price, broken down by deliverable. A proposed timeline. The Zoho edition you’re assuming. Any assumptions you’ve made.

opportunities.title: Mystery Shopper Telefónico Restaurantes CDMX
opportunities.description: Busco a alguien que realice llamadas de incógnito a distintos restaurantes y cafeterías dentro de la Ciudad de México y su zona metropolitana. El objetivo es evaluar, de forma discreta, cómo capturan los pedidos y los datos del cliente cuando se solicita un pedido sencillo del menú. Qué necesito: • De 10 a 15 llamadas distribuidas entre varios establecimientos que yo proporcionaré. • Registro detallado por llamada: fecha, hora, nombre del negocio, nombre del operador (si se proporciona) y transcripción breve. • Evaluación clara sobre la toma correcta de pedidos y datos (exactitud, repetición del pedido, confirmación de dirección o número de contacto, etc.). • Archivo de resultados en Google Sheets o Excel, más un comentario final con hallazgos generales y recomendaciones. Detalles clave: • El foco está únicamente en la fase de “Toma correcta de pedidos y datos”. No es necesario valorar amabilidad, tiempos de espera ni otros factores, salvo que afecten directamente a esa toma. • Todas las llamadas deben plantear pedidos sencillos del menú, sin cambios especiales ni órdenes grandes. • Las conversaciones deben mantenerse naturales; no reveles que se trata de una evaluación. • La información recopilada será de uso interno y confidencial. Entrego lista de números y un guion sugerido. Solo necesito las grabaciones (si tu equipo lo permite) y el reporte completo en un plazo máximo de una semana después de la adjudicación.

opportunities.title: Interior Designer Needed: 3D Renderings, Finish Schedule & Dimensional Layouts
opportunities.description: I am looking for a talented junior-to-intermediate interior designer or high-end e-designer to handle the aesthetic design for a large residential project. The project includes 9 major zones: • 1 Great Room • 1 Main Kitchen • 1 Spice Kitchen • 6 Washrooms I already have a seasoned builder executing the project to code and handles all structural/technical elements. I will provide you with the complete architectural floor plans in both PDF and CAD format. Your job will be strictly focused on the interior aesthetics, visual space planning, and material selections. Required Deliverables: 1. 3D Renderings: High-quality, photo-realistic 3D visual renderings (2–3 angles per room) showing the design concept. The style must be clean Modern or warm Transitional. 2. Detailed Finish Schedule: A comprehensive spreadsheet detailing all paint selections, flooring, tile placement, countertops, cabinet styles, and decorative lighting fixtures with clickable sourcing links. 3. Dimensional Layouts & Elevations: Using my CAD files, you must provide the precise aesthetic dimensions for the builder. This includes cabinet heights/widths, fireplace feature wall layout dimensions, and tile layout maps for the washrooms so the trades know exactly where to install materials.

opportunities.title: Agentes de Ventas B2B América Latina，Solo para personas cuya lengua materna sea el español o el portugués
opportunities.description: Busco agentes de ventas residentes en Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, Caracas, Valencia (VE), Guayaquil, Quito, La Paz o São Paulo que tengan el español o el portugués como lengua materna y una sólida trayectoria comercial. Nos dedicamos a productos industriales o empresariales y necesitamos reforzar la presencia en ferias regionales y el contacto directo con distribuidores, mayoristas y comercios. El trabajo se extiende hasta 2027, de modo que valoro la constancia y la visión a largo plazo. Funciones del puesto: .Antes de la feria: llamar a los clientes potenciales Durante cada feria: recopilar los datos de posibles clientes con rigor y orden. • Después del evento: llamar a cada prospecto para presentar la empresa y pactar una reunión. • En la fase de cierre: visitar al cliente cuando sea necesario para afianzar la relación y avanzar en la negociación. Visitar los mercados locales en busca de clientes potenciales Perfil que encaja Eres meticuloso, sereno y analítico; disfrutas del trato telefónico y presencial; manejas tu propio calendario y cuidas cada seguimiento en un CRM o en hojas de cálculo compartidas. Experiencia previa en ventas B2B es indispensable. Si vives en una de las ciudades indicadas y quieres crecer conmigo en este mercado industrial, espero tu propuesta detallando tu experiencia específica y la disponibilidad para viajar dentro de tu región cuando se requiera.

opportunities.title: Ia Engineer | Machine Learning Engineer
opportunities.description: IA Engineer | Machine Learning Engineer Buscamos un/a **IA Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer** para sumarse a un proyecto tecnológico y participar en el desarrollo e implementación de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos experiencia práctica en: - Python: pandas, NumPy y scikit-learn. - Entrenamiento de modelos con **XGBoost, LightGBM o CatBoost**. - Feature Engineering y datos transaccionales. - SQL: MySQL / PostgreSQL. - FastAPI, Docker y puesta en producción de modelos. - MLflow o herramientas similares. - Monitoreo, drift y reentrenamiento de modelos. Valoramos experiencia en **sistemas antifraude, motores de recomendación y modelos predictivos**. Buscamos alguien que pueda trabajar sobre todo el ciclo de IA: **analizar el problema, desarrollar el modelo, evaluar resultados y llevarlo a producción**. - Modalidad - 100% remoto. - Contratación freelance / por horas. - Posibilidad de continuidad. opportunities.description: Buscamos un investigador/a remoto por contrato para localizar y verificar información de contacto actualizada de clientes potenciales. Es un puesto únicamente de investigación: no hay comunicación con clientes ni con clientes potenciales, y no se requiere inglés. El trabajoRealizar búsquedas en TLO (TLOxp) e IDI Data (idiCORE) para localizar números de teléfono, correos electrónicos y direcciones postales actuales Verificar y contrastar los resultados con registros públicos y otras fuentes para garantizar que la información sea actual y precisa Registrar los resultados en nuestra base de datos / software propietario, de forma limpia y organizada, indicando la fuente de cada dato Trabajar con nuestras cuentas acreditadas de las bases de datos, respetando estrictamente las reglas de uso permitido de cada plataforma Horario y pago De 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, contrato continuo Entre $5 y $7 USD por hora, según la experiencia Requisitos Experiencia práctica con tlo y/o idi data — indique qué plataformas ha utilizado, durante cuánto tiempo y con qué frecuencia experiencia en localización de personas (skip tracing), investigaciones, investigación para cobranzas, apoyo legal o trabajos de investigación similares sólidas habilidades de investigación en registros públicos y excelente atención al detalle computadora propia y conexión a internet estable discreción en el manejo de datos personales para postularse, responda las preguntas de selección a continuación. 1. ¿Qué bases de datos de búsqueda de personas ha utilizado personalmente: TLOxp, IDI Data (idiCORE), LexisNexis Accurint, Thomson Reuters CLEAR u otras? ¿Durante cuánto tiempo y cuántas búsquedas realiza en un día típico? 2. Cuando una búsqueda devuelve varias coincidencias posibles para el mismo nombre, explique paso a paso cómo confirma cuál es la persona correcta. 3. ¿Qué datos adicionales le ayudan más a acotar una búsqueda (fecha de nacimiento, última dirección conocida, nombres de familiares, un número de teléfono parcial)? 4. ¿Cómo verifica que un número de teléfono o correo electrónico encontrado esté vigente y pertenezca a esa persona, y no esté desactualizado o sea de otra persona? 5. Aproximadamente, ¿cuántos registros de contacto completamente verificados puede completar en un turno de 8 horas? 6. ¿Está disponible de 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, de forma continua? ¿Qué hora es esa en su lugar de residencia? 7. ¿Ha trabajado antes con la cuenta acreditada de bases de datos de un empleador? ¿Conoce las reglas de uso permitido de estas bases de datos? El trabajoRealizar búsquedas en TLO (TLOxp) e IDI Data (idiCORE) para localizar números de teléfono, correos electrónicos y direcciones postales actuales Verificar y contrastar los resultados con registros públicos y otras fuentes para garantizar que la información sea actual y precisa Registrar los resultados en nuestra base de datos / software propietario, de forma limpia y organizada, indicando la fuente de cada dato Trabajar con nuestras cuentas acreditadas de las bases de datos, respetando estrictamente las reglas de uso permitido de cada plataforma Horario y pago De 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, contrato continuo Entre $5 y $7 USD por hora, según la experiencia Requisitos Experiencia práctica con tlo y/o idi data — indique qué plataformas ha utilizado, durante cuánto tiempo y con qué frecuencia experiencia en localización de personas (skip tracing), investigaciones, investigación para cobranzas, apoyo legal o trabajos de investigación similares sólidas habilidades de investigación en registros públicos y excelente atención al detalle computadora propia y conexión a internet estable discreción en el manejo de datos personales para postularse, responda las preguntas de selección a continuación. 1. ¿Qué bases de datos de búsqueda de personas ha utilizado personalmente: TLOxp, IDI Data (idiCORE), LexisNexis Accurint, Thomson Reuters CLEAR u otras? ¿Durante cuánto tiempo y cuántas búsquedas realiza en un día típico? 2. Cuando una búsqueda devuelve varias coincidencias posibles para el mismo nombre, explique paso a paso cómo confirma cuál es la persona correcta. 3. ¿Qué datos adicionales le ayudan más a acotar una búsqueda (fecha de nacimiento, última dirección conocida, nombres de familiares, un número de teléfono parcial)? 4. ¿Cómo verifica que un número de teléfono o correo electrónico encontrado esté vigente y pertenezca a esa persona, y no esté desactualizado o sea de otra persona? 5. Aproximadamente, ¿cuántos registros de contacto completamente verificados puede completar en un turno de 8 horas? 6. ¿Está disponible de 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, de forma continua? ¿Qué hora es esa en su lugar de residencia? 7. ¿Ha trabajado antes con la cuenta acreditada de bases de datos de un empleador? ¿Conoce las reglas de uso permitido de estas bases de datos? opportunities.title: Video Tutorial de Apps
opportunities.description: Quiero publicar en YouTube un video de entre 8 y 10 minutos que enseñe, paso a paso, cómo utilizar una aplicación para móvil o computadora. Alcance • Redacta un guion claro y didáctico que cubra introducción, demostración práctica y conclusión con llamadas a la acción. • Graba o captura pantalla en alta resolución (mínimo 1080p) mostrando cada paso dentro de la app. • Incluye locución en español neutro sincronizada con la demostración, cuidando ritmo y entonación para facilitar el aprendizaje. • Añade gráficos simples, subtítulos y música libre de derechos para mantener la atención. Entregables 1. Video final en formato MP4 listo para subir a YouTube. 2. Archivo editable del proyecto (por ejemplo, Premiere Pro, Final Cut o DaVinci). 3. Guion en PDF o DOC con marcas de tiempo. Criterios de aceptación – Duración entre 8:00 y 10:00 minutos. – Audio claro, sin ruidos ni picos. – Texto en pantalla y subtítulos sin faltas ortográficas. – Flujo lógico que lleve al usuario desde la instalación hasta el uso de las funciones principales de la aplicación. Si ya cuentas con ejemplos de tutoriales similares, compártelos para evaluar estilo y calidad. Estoy disponible para responder dudas y proporcionar acceso a la app o recursos adicionales que necesites.

opportunities.title: Aplicación Web Consumo API
opportunities.description: Quiero una aplicación web que consuma mi servicio REST a través de varios endpoints protegidos con autenticación Bearer Token. El token ya estará embebido en la app, por lo que no habrá pantalla de inicio de sesión: solo necesito que cada petición incluya automáticamente el encabezado Authorization correspondiente. Alcance • Conectar a los endpoints que te proporcionaré e inyectar el Bearer Token en todas las llamadas. • Mostrar los datos en una interfaz limpia y responsive que funcione en cualquier navegador moderno. • Permitir al usuario ver la información y buscarla mediante filtros o cuadro de búsqueda. Requisitos técnicos • Puedes trabajar con React, Vue, Angular o vanilla JavaScript; elige la opción que mejor domines. • Manejo de estados y peticiones asíncronas con fetch, Axios o equivalente. • Estructura de archivos clara y comentada para que pueda mantenerla después. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo. 2. Breve guía de instalación/ejecución (README). 3. Demostración funcional alojada en un entorno temporal (por ejemplo Netlify, Vercel o similar) para revisión inicial. Valoraré un diseño simple pero pulido, uso correcto de promesas/async-await y buenas prácticas de seguridad al almacenar el token en memoria.
